task: Implement the Kudos like (thả tim) feature on the Live board (MoMorph screen MaZUn5xHXZ), persisting likes and the resulting heart ledger to the local Supabase project. Spec row C.4.1 Hearts is authoritative.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the heart on a kudos card persists a like row and the new count survives a full page reload (TC 7a7ec63e).
Clicking the heart again removes the like and the count returns to its pre-like value, also surviving reload (TC 7a7ec63e).
The heart icon renders gray when not liked by the viewer and red when liked, with aria-pressed reflecting the persisted state (TC 7a7ec63e).
A viewer whose resolved profile slug equals the kudos senderId sees the heart button disabled and cannot like it (TC 63645b03, BR-002).
A second like attempt by the same user on the same kudos never creates a second row; the unique constraint holds at the database level (TC 91e102ba).
An unauthenticated visitor can load /kudos and read real like counts, and the heart button renders disabled with an explanatory aria-label (TC 71b3ef43, clarifications decision 5).
Each like credits the kudos SENDER's heart ledger by 1 on a normal day (spec C.4.1 grant sentence, clarifications decision 3).
A like placed while a special_days row covers the current date credits 2 instead of 1, and stores is_special=true on the like row (TC 31936b72).
Unliking revokes exactly the amount that like granted, read from the like row's stored is_special flag, not recomputed from today's date (spec C.4.1 QA note).
The sidebar row "Số tim bạn nhận được:" reads the real ledger for the signed-in viewer; the other four D.1 rows stay the static 25 placeholders (clarifications decision 6).
The displayed per-card count equals the record's static heartCount plus the real like delta (clarifications decision 1).
RLS prevents a client from writing a kudos_likes row attributed to another user.
